prior_research.notes: Could not source a specific named public project matching 'Cairo Ring–Port Said Gas Pipeline' (130km) despite an extensive search: the Ministry of Petroleum's official 'national gas grid lines' PDF (2020, https://www.petroleum.gov.eg/ar-eg/gas-and-petrol/distribution-marketing-transporting/Documents/2020خطوط_الشبكة_القومية_للغازات_الطبيعية.pdf) is prose-only and names no line-by-line projects; a trade-press '39 projects' list (petro-news.com/95212/) and a '16,000km' list (youm7.com) both enumerate ~9 named national gas trunks built 2014-2023 with none matching this name/length; GASCO's own site (gasco.com.eg/gas-grid) gives only grid-wide totals, not a project list; multiple Arabic-language searches for 'الحلقي'/'الدائري' (ring) + بورسعيد, and for an Ismailia–Port Said line, returned only adjacent-but-distinct projects: 'Duplication of the Gamal–Damietta gas line' (42in, 50km, Damietta/Port Said governorates, presidency.eg) and 'Development of the West Port Said gas-processing station' (presidency.eg) — neither matches this PID's length or the 'Cairo Ring' descriptor. Best working hypothesis (UNVERIFIED): a segment of a Cairo-area gas ring-main / distribution hub extended east toward Port Said, plausibly related to or overlapping the same corridor as the El Tina–Abu Sultan–NAC trunk (P8002) which itself crosses Port Said governorate — but no source ties this specific 130km figure or a 'Cairo Ring' name to a documented project. Recommend a follow-up pass once WebSearch quota resets, or checking GASCO/EGAS's internal project archive directly; leaving as ROUTE_PARTIAL (corridor-only, no endpoints) rather than guessing coordinates.

start.name: El Kureimat power station complex
start.coord_basis: OSM/Nominatim geocode of 'قرية الكريمات' (Kureimat village), Giza Governorate — nearest named place to the power complex; the plant's own gate coordinate is not published.

end.name: Al Tebbin (El Tebbin) thermal power station
end.coord_basis: OSM/Nominatim geocode of 'محطة كهرباء التبين' (Tebbin power station), an industrial-landuse polygon in Helwan, Cairo Governorate.

prior_research.notes: Both endpoint FACILITIES are independently, publicly confirmed via official EEHC-subsidiary pages: Kureimat station (ueepc.com — Upper Egypt Electricity Production Co.: Giza Governorate, Atfih district, ~95km from Cairo, gas/mazout-fired, matches the hint's ~29.2N/31.23E) and Tebbin station (cairoepc.com — Cairo Electricity Production Co.: on the Nile Corniche, Tebbin district, Cairo, 700MW, gas/mazout-fired). HOWEVER, no public source found in this pass documents the SPECIFIC 87km GAS PIPELINE connecting them — the only 'Kureimat–Tebbin' line found in search was a same-named ELECTRICITY transmission line (almalnews.com, on a 2016 repair-cost story; a Ministerial Decree 75/2016 also references it), which is a power line, not gas, and must not be conflated. Marking resolved:false per the 'source the pipeline claim, not just the place' requirement, despite having good coordinates for both plausible endpoints — these are offered as a strong lead for a follow-up search pass (try GASCO/EGAS project archives, or Arabic press once WebSearch quota resets), not as a sourced pipeline route.

prior_research.notes: No source found naming a distinct 6.1 km 'SUMED Gas Pipeline' with its own endpoints. Corridor hypothesis only: GASCO (engineering/PM) and Petrojet (construction) built marine and onshore pipelines at SUMED Port, Ain Sokhna to carry regasified LNG from the FSRU marine berth into the national gas grid (Egyptian Gazette, Daily News Egypt) — P8005 is plausibly the short onshore continuation of P8004's offshore leg (SUMED terminal landfall to a national-grid tie-in point a few km inland), but no source states a distinct length, a named tie-in facility, or its own coordinate. Recommend a follow-up pass with fresh search budget: Egypt Oil & Gas / Enterprise Press archives, GASCO project pages, or Arabic search ('خط أنابيب سوميد للغاز', 'الشبكة القومية') targeting the onshore segment specifically.
